title: Heroes of Newerth
author: emulsifier
body: I know this isn’t a webcomic about gaming, but I play a lot of games, and I’ve got 3 beta keys for HoN available. Reply to this thread and give us some feedback on what you’d like to see done with the site and which comic you want to see updated next (and possibly why) if you are interested in one. Once you get the key, be sure to find me in game. My handle is, of course, emulsifier.
